#### **Overview**

This project focused on using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to analyze website performance and user behavior. Through dashboard reports and exploratory analysis, I evaluated key performance indicators (KPIs), user engagement, traffic sources, and conversion activity. The project emphasized using data to identify trends and support marketing decisions.

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

#### **Learning Outcomes**

- Analyze website performance using Google Analytics 4.
- Interpret user behavior through reports and dashboards.
- Evaluate marketing KPIs to support business decisions.
- Identify opportunities to improve website performance.
- Communicate findings using data visualizations.

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

#### **Key Skills Gained**

- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
- Marketing Analytics
- Dashboard Interpretation
- KPI Analysis
- Data Visualization
- Data-Driven Decision Making
